FINAL IVX SOURCE-OF-TRUTH HANDOFF + RECOVERY AUDIT

MODE: READ-ONLY DISCOVERY
DO NOT MODIFY CODE.
DO NOT CREATE NEW CODE.
DO NOT REFACTOR.
DO NOT DELETE ANYTHING.
DO NOT DEPLOY.
DO NOT GENERATE NARRATIVE CERTIFICATIONS.
DO NOT CLAIM PASS WITHOUT EXECUTED EVIDENCE.

We are transferring IVX to independent ownership and need the complete factual source of truth.

==================================================
1. LOCATE ALL 12 IVX AI SYSTEMS
==================================================

Find EVERY one of the 12 IVX AI systems previously created, planned, scheduled, implemented, or partially implemented.

For EACH AI return:

AI_NUMBER:
EXACT_NAME:
PURPOSE:
STATUS: IMPLEMENTED / PARTIAL / PLANNED / MISSING
CAN_EXECUTE_NOW: YES / NO / UNKNOWN

CANONICAL_SOURCE_PATHS:
ENTRYPOINT:
BACKEND_SERVICE:
FRONTEND_MODULE:
API_ENDPOINT:
DATABASE_TABLES:
EXTERNAL_SERVICES:

TEST_FILES:
TESTS_EXECUTED:
TEST_RESULT:
LAST_RELEVANT_COMMIT_SHA:

RUNTIME_EVIDENCE:
MISSING_WORK:

Do not count documentation, plans, UI labels, or narrative as implemented AI systems.

==================================================
2. LOCATE ALL 50 FACTORY APPS
==================================================

Find EVERY one of the 50 Factory Apps previously created, generated, planned, scheduled, or stored.

Return a numbered inventory:

01–50

For EACH:

APP_NUMBER:
EXACT_NAME:
PURPOSE:
TYPE:
- SOURCE APP
- TEMPLATE
- GENERATOR
- DATABASE RECORD
- SCHEDULED FACTORY JOB
- PARTIAL IMPLEMENTATION
- PLAN ONLY
- MISSING

EXACT_SOURCE_PATH:
FACTORY_DEFINITION_PATH:
GENERATOR_PATH:
DATABASE_LOCATION:
SCHEDULER_JOB:
BUILD_CONFIGURATION:

CAN_FACTORY_GENERATE_NOW: YES / NO / UNKNOWN
BUILD_EXECUTED: YES / NO
BUILD_RESULT:
TEST_EVIDENCE:
LAST_RELEVANT_COMMIT_SHA:
MISSING_WORK:

Do NOT count the same app twice because copies exist in legacy folders.

==================================================
3. AUTONOMOUS — FIND ITS REAL SCHEDULER
==================================================

Locate the complete Autonomous scheduling system.

Return:

AUTONOMOUS_ENTRYPOINT:
WORKER_PATH:
QUEUE_PATH:
SCHEDULER_PATH:
CALENDAR_PATH:
CRON_PATH:
DATABASE_TABLE:
API_ENDPOINTS:
RUNTIME_SERVICE:

Then list ALL jobs/tasks related to:

- 12 IVX AI systems
- 50 Factory Apps
- Senior Developer
- Factory Engine
- self-improvement
- app generation
- module generation
- pending autonomous work

For EACH scheduled task return:

TASK_ID:
TASK_NAME:
CREATED_AT:
SCHEDULED_FOR:
STATUS:
TARGET:
SOURCE_PATH:
DATABASE_RECORD:
LAST_EXECUTION:
RESULT:
REMAINING_WORK:

If "calendar" is an internal IVX scheduler and NOT Google Calendar, explicitly identify where it lives.

==================================================
4. SEARCH ALL LEGACY / RORK LOCATIONS
==================================================

Search ALL historical locations before declaring anything missing.

Include:

.rork/
.rork/history/
.rork/plans/
home/user/rork-app/
home/user/rork-app/backend/
home/user/rork-app/expo/
recovery/
old branches
Git history
generated files
Supabase/database records
Render/runtime references
Factory artifacts
scheduler records

IMPORTANT:

Do NOT delete or clean these directories.

They may contain months of IVX development that must be recovered first.

==================================================
5. CANONICAL VS DUPLICATE CODE
==================================================

Identify every major duplicated IVX subsystem.

Especially compare:

backend/...

against:

home/user/rork-app/backend/...

For each duplicate report:

CANONICAL:
LEGACY:
SAME / DIFFERENT:
IMPORTANT CODE ONLY IN LEGACY:
IMPORTANT CODE ONLY IN CANONICAL:
RECOMMENDED RECOVERY:

Do NOT merge anything automatically.

==================================================
6. IVX AUTONOMOUS SENIOR DEVELOPER
==================================================

Locate and document the real implementation for:

Owner Chat
Autonomous handoff
Senior Developer Router
Pre-execution gate
Worker
Durable queue
Factory Engine
Factory Planner
Code executor
Tests
GitHub commit/push
Deployment
Production verification
Proof ledger
Rollback/recovery
Self-improvement

For each provide:

EXACT_PATH:
FUNCTION/CLASS:
STATUS:
EXECUTION_EVIDENCE:
KNOWN_BLOCKER:

==================================================
7. FACTORY CAPABILITY
==================================================

Prove whether Factory currently supports REAL execution of:

CREATE APP FROM SCRATCH
CREATE MODULE
CREATE DIRECTORY
CREATE MULTIPLE FILES
INSTALL DEPENDENCY
DATABASE/SUPABASE MIGRATION
RUN TESTS
RUN TYPECHECK
RUN BUILD
APK
AAB
IPA
WEB BUILD
CREATE TOOL
SELF-UPGRADE
COMMIT TO GITHUB
PUSH
DEPLOY
VERIFY PRODUCTION

For each:

CAPABILITY:
IMPLEMENTED:
PATH:
FUNCTION:
TEST:
LAST_EXECUTED:
PASS/FAIL/UNVERIFIED:

UNVERIFIED is mandatory when no executed evidence exists.

==================================================
8. NO FAKE PROOF
==================================================

The following are NOT acceptable as proof:

- narrative
- screenshots saying PASS
- generated certification text
- planned architecture
- TODO lists
- Task IDs not backed by runtime records
- fake progress percentages
- unexecuted tests
- unverified deployments
- statements such as "production ready" without production evidence

Every factual implementation claim MUST provide at least one:

FILE PATH + FUNCTION
COMMIT SHA
TEST EXECUTION
DATABASE RECORD
RUNTIME RECORD
DEPLOYMENT ID
LIVE ENDPOINT VERIFICATION

==================================================
9. FINAL RECOVERY MATRIX
==================================================

Return ONE final matrix:

A. 12 IVX AI
FOUND:
IMPLEMENTED:
PARTIAL:
MISSING:
EXECUTABLE NOW:

B. 50 FACTORY APPS
FOUND:

==================================================
10. FINAL RULE
==================================================

THIS TASK IS DISCOVERY + RECOVERY ONLY.

DO NOT "fix" missing components.
DO NOT regenerate the 12 AI.
DO NOT regenerate the 50 Factory Apps.
DO NOT rewrite Autonomous.
DO NOT clean Rork history.
DO NOT deploy.

We need to know WHERE THE EXISTING WORK IS FIRST.

If something cannot be proven, write:

UNVERIFIED — EVIDENCE NOT FOUND

If something does not exist, write:

MISSING — NO IMPLEMENTATION FOUND

At the end output:

HANDOFF_STATUS:
12_AI_FOUND: X/12
50_FACTORY_APPS_FOUND: X/50
AUTONOMOUS_SCHEDULER_FOUND: YES/NO
LEGACY_RECOVERY_REQUIRED: YES/NO

NO NARRATIVE CERTIFICATION.
NO SIMULATED RESULTS.
SOURCE-OF-TRUTH EVIDENCE ONLY.
